title: Kalunga2016 – SSVEP Exo dataset
description: This dataset contains 8-channel EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing an SSVEP-based brain-computer interface task, originally collected for an online, asynchronous BCI for assistive robotics using an exoskeleton-equipped wheelchair. Participants focused on LEDs flickering at 13, 17 and 21 Hz, or on a fixation point for a rest (reject) class, following auditory cues. The data are provided in BIDS format, converted via MOABB from the original Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 256 Hz with a g.tec MobiLab amplifier from 8 occipital and parieto-occipital electrodes (Oz, O1, O2, POz, PO3, PO4, PO7, PO8), referenced to the right mastoid. A panel with three groups of four LEDs blinking at different frequencies was placed to the left of the wheelchair. Each 5 s trial started with an audio cue and was followed by a 3 s pause. Each session consisted of 32 trials, 8 per frequency (13, 17, 21 Hz) plus 8 rest trials.
